selection.reason: Keep the seven-module feature selection and its bound design plan. Add explicit lifecycle repair requirements within existing scope; retain complete privacy and boundary sanity, original failures and the original feature300s publication clock. Execute every selected category without filtering, skipping or quarantine. Use medium maximum reasoning and synthetic engine adapters without paid fallback; leave the recurrence catalog unchanged.

spec.title: Sealed proposal specifications and reliable review completion
acceptance: Engine dispatch honors explicit selection and harness-based automatic selection. Missing executables terminate the request without alternate-engine or paid fallback execution.

Structured adapter execution exposes inspection tools only, disables MCP and persistent sessions, removes inherited harness markers, and requires an identifiable model and unambiguous decision. External inputs are supplied only after custody and digest verification; drift prevents dispatch.

Proposal admission uses freshly fetched remote main consistently across generated records. Fetch failure, unresolved conflicts, an incorrect branch or missing remote ancestry prevents selection issuance.
Canonical specification encoding matches the reference vector, preserves Unicode deterministically, rejects duplicate keys and invalid number forms, and detects alteration of sealed content.

The launcher supplies engine and model provenance, implementation digests, execution location, UTC issuance time and input hashes. Behavioral model output cannot replace launcher-generated provenance.

Executable contracts require an approved specification with a valid seal and matching proposal digest, base, design, scope and selected module set. Runtime entries outside the declared scope are refused.

Published specification strings reject sensitive credentials, address values and private home locations. Issuance also rejects prohibited textual overlap with private inputs; later verification preserves checks that need no private text.

Documentation contracts omit specifications and reject attached ones. Focused repair contracts retain complete assertion-based failure reproduction followed by successful execution with unchanged reproduction inputs.

Release admission rejects executable changes without the required contract and rejects invalid specification state before starting checks. Documentation exceptions remain bounded, and transported native evidence must satisfy exact-source and complete command requirements.

Both proposal adapters generate a single sealed selection consumed by existing validation and publication flows. Implementation guidance and mirrored instructions consistently describe synchronization, proposal generation, category execution, independent source review and publication.

An already validated commit is assessed again when its available live receipt fails verification, including observed ignored-file drift. An intact applicable receipt preserves the unchanged-candidate fast path; receipt absence retains the established checkpoint behavior.

Receipt admission requires the issuing run outcome and, for a genuine native parent, its controller outcome. Adopted legacy attempts complete through their own terminal records without a circular controller dependency. Incomplete terminal admission cannot establish validated readiness.
Rewriting a newly issued receipt remains rejected by its terminal binding. Historical receipts without terminal metadata retain only their established content-bound verification behavior.

Git interception preserves standard input for batched path hashing. Synthetic producer repositories exclude foreign selection state, intake fixtures obtain required commands from the producer, and launcher helpers use consistent harness-neutral environments. The complete lifecycle module finishes with every test passing and no skipped, cancelled or pending cases.

tests.purpose: Verify specification admission, class rules, reproduction requirements and validation input bindings.
Exercise early release rejection and bounded documentation admission.
Check native evidence custody and complete publication command coverage.
Exercise receipt freshness, terminal completion, historical compatibility, concurrent recovery and isolated synthetic harnesses.
Verify canonical encoding, provenance, privacy protections and specification consistency.
Exercise engine selection, restricted adapters, external input custody and remote-base admission.
Verify end-to-end proposal generation and consistent implementation instructions.
